careerTimeline.title: Member of Parliament (Lok Sabha)
careerTimeline.description: Contested and won the 14th general elections from Amethi, Uttar Pradesh, securing a victory by over 100,000 votes.

careerTimeline.title: Standing Committee on Home Affairs
careerTimeline.description: Served as a member of the Standing Committee on Home Affairs.

careerTimeline.title: Standing Committee on HRD
careerTimeline.description: Served as a member of the Standing Committee on Human Resource Development.

careerTimeline.title: General Secretary (AICC)
careerTimeline.description: Appointed as the general secretary of the All India Congress Committee (AICC) and given charge of the Indian Youth Congress (IYC) and NSUI.

careerTimeline.title: Retained Amethi Seat
careerTimeline.description: Won the 2009 Indian general election from Amethi by a massive margin of over 370,000 votes.

careerTimeline.title: Vice-President of INC
careerTimeline.description: Named Vice-President of the Indian National Congress. Retained the Amethi Lok Sabha seat by defeating Smriti Irani.

careerTimeline.title: Member of Parliament, Wayanad
careerTimeline.description: Won the Wayanad Lok Sabha seat in Kerala with over 60% vote share. Led the national election campaign.

careerTimeline.title: Leader of Opposition, Lok Sabha
careerTimeline.description: Won the Rae Bareli constituency. Assumed the constitutional role of Leader of the Official Opposition in the Lok Sabha.
